about.title: A calmer way to learn science
about.subtitle: PhysChem Lab is an open, bilingual study companion made for learners who want to understand, not memorise.
about.openText: No account, paywall or tracking wall. Your bookmarks and progress stay in your browser.
about.bilingualText: Use Bangla for confidence, English for wider scientific vocabulary, or switch between them at any moment.
about.visualText: A formula is a starting point. Simulations and experiments help you connect symbols to evidence.
about.creditsText: Original interface and learning notes are released for educational use. Please credit PhysChem Lab when adapting the project.
